_note: 中国学习者的经典英语错误，每条一对最小差异句。right 是正确的，wrong 是典型错法。

pairs.right: I arrived in Beijing yesterday.
He is good at math.
It depends on you.
I listened to music all night.
She is married to a doctor.
pairs.wrong: She is married with a doctor.

pairs.right: We discussed the problem.
I will call you in the morning.
pairs.wrong: I will call you at the morning.

pairs.right: He got on the bus.
I am a student.
She plays the piano very well.
The sun rises in the east.
He is the tallest boy in our class.
pairs.wrong: He is tallest boy in our class.

pairs.right: I had an interesting idea.
Life is short.
He gave me some advice.
I need more information.
That is a piece of good news.
We bought a lot of furniture.
pairs.wrong: We bought a lot of furnitures.

pairs.right: He has much homework tonight.
He goes to school by bike.
pairs.wrong: He go to school by bike.

pairs.right: Everyone is here.
There are three books on the desk.
pairs.wrong: There is three books on the desk.

pairs.right: My family has moved to Shanghai.
pairs.wrong: My family have moved to Shanghai.

pairs.right: It took me three hours to write it.
pairs.wrong: I took three hours to write it.

pairs.right: I have lived here for five years.
pairs.wrong: I live here for five years.

pairs.right: He has been ill since Monday.
I was born in 1990.
Although it rained, I still went.
pairs.wrong: Although it rained, but I still went.

pairs.right: Because he was ill, he didn't come.
pairs.wrong: Because he was ill, so he didn't come.

pairs.right: I like it very much.
Welcome to Beijing.
There are many people here.
I think he is not right.
pairs.wrong: I think he is not correct so.

pairs.right: Please turn on the light.
You should take this medicine twice a day.
pairs.wrong: You should eat this medicine twice a day.

pairs.right: I would like a cup of strong tea.
pairs.wrong: I would like a cup of thick tea.

pairs.right: There was heavy rain last night.
pairs.wrong: There was big rain last night.

pairs.right: He made a serious mistake.
The traffic is heavy this morning.
pairs.wrong: The traffic is crowded this morning.

pairs.right: I am interested in history.
The film was boring.
I was surprised by the news.
pairs.wrong: I was surprising by the news.
